title: Grove Delegates are publicly pseudonymous but privately identified, making the Foundation the sole holder of the identity mapping
content:
A.6.1.1.2.3.1.4.4.2.1 sets the arrangement out plainly: "Every prospective Delegate must complete an initial, **confidential** identity verification process with the Grove Foundation, subject to additional KYC verification as necessary in the future. **Delegates may remain anonymous or pseudonymous to the public.**"

A.6.1.1.2.3.1.4.4.1 supplies the surrounding authority: "The Grove Foundation manages Delegate onboarding. The Grove Foundation **may onboard a Delegate at its discretion**. The Grove Foundation conducts identity verification, conflict-of-interest collection, and sanctions and undue-risk checks **as it deems necessary**."

The design splits accountability from exposure. Public pseudonymity protects delegates from the pressure, retaliation and physical risk that come with being a visibly influential voter in a token system — a real concern that has driven participants out of comparable roles. Private verification means that protection is not anonymity from *everyone*: someone knows, holds the conflict disclosures, and has run sanctions screening.

The structural cost is that this concentrates a great deal in one body. The Foundation is the only party who can connect a registry entry to a person, and its onboarding power is discretionary twice over — it "may onboard at its discretion" and performs checks "as it deems necessary," with no stated criteria, no appeal, and no obligation to explain a refusal. Since only Active Delegates may receive delegated voting power, control over the delegate roster is control over who may accumulate influence in Grove governance.

The result is a governance system that is decentralized in its voting and centralized at its gate. Every accountability mechanism the framework defines — conflict disclosure, sanctions screening, offboarding for non-performance — runs through the Foundation, so the framework's integrity rests on an actor whose own constraints are specified nowhere in this material.
description: Every prospective Delegate completes confidential identity verification with the Grove Foundation, which onboards at its discretion, while remaining anonymous or pseudonymous to the public.
